claim: At the first four-document break point, separate an insufficient optimization horizon from insufficient tiny-model capacity without changing data, objective, sampler, decoder, seed or gates after observing outcomes.

execution.entry: anima-py and the existing Python ByteGPT engine only
execution.models_and_training_data: private Hugging Face dancinlab repositories only

fixed_recipe.objective: assistant-turn-only including the next canonical user-role delimiter
fixed_recipe.schedule: 50-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio at each registered endpoint

gates.baseline_reproduction: teacher top-1 within 0.002 of 0.6977964323, target-prefix 2/4 and structural 1/4
gates.arm_memorization: teacher top-1 >= 0.95, exact response 4/4, target-prefix 4/4 and structural 4/4
gates.prompt_causality: normal gold-response CE below blank and cyclic-shuffle controls on 4/4, with normal output changed by at least one intervention on 4/4
gates.interpretation: an arm passes only when both memorization and prompt-causality gates pass

decision_table.BASELINE_MISMATCH: invalid experiment; repair or explain reproduction before interpreting treatments
decision_table.ONLY_CAPACITY_PASS: support tiny capacity or geometry at the fixed horizon
decision_table.O1_AND_CAPACITY_PASS: both levers can fit four documents; require a later compute-matched choice without promoting either post hoc
decision_table.NO_TREATMENT_PASS: the bounded horizon and capacity variants do not repair conditional learning
decision_table.BASELINE_PASS_ONLY: registered failure reproduced and no treatment is supported
